bodyHtml:
Which one should you choose?

Pick ChatGPT if you want one subscription that covers the most jobs — writing, images, voice, research and custom GPTs in a single app.

Pick Claude if you write long documents or code for a living. Its writing sounds the most natural, and Pro includes Claude Code, an agent that edits whole projects.
verdict: ChatGPT is the best all-rounder: the widest feature set of any chatbot — chat, images, voice, deep research and custom GPTs — for Plus at $20 a month. Claude is the better writer, with the most human-sounding long-form writing and the fewest dropped details in very long documents, and Claude Pro includes Claude Code. Pay for ChatGPT Plus if you want one tool for everything; pay for Claude Pro if you write or code for a living.

bodyHtml:
Which one should you choose?

Pick ChatGPT if you want one tool for the most jobs, including images, voice and custom GPTs.

Pick Gemini if your documents, email and files already live in Google Workspace — its Gmail, Docs and Drive integration is the reason to pay.
verdict: ChatGPT has the most complete package of any chatbot: image generation and editing, voice, deep research and custom GPTs, for Plus at $20 a month. Gemini is strongest when your work already lives in Google apps — Gmail, Docs and Drive — with multimodal skills and Veo video generation through Flow, for AI Pro at $19.99 a month. Pick ChatGPT for the widest range of features; pick Gemini if your workday runs on Google Workspace.

bodyHtml:
Which one should you choose?

Pick Claude if you write, research or code for a living — its writing is the most human-sounding, and Pro includes Claude Code.

Pick Gemini if your work already lives in Google Workspace. Its Gmail, Docs and Drive integration is the deciding factor.
verdict: Claude produces the most natural long-form writing and handles very long documents with the fewest dropped details, and Claude Pro includes Claude Code for whole-project coding work. Gemini answers with deep Google Workspace integration — Gmail, Docs and Drive — plus Veo video generation through Flow. Writers and coders should pick Claude Pro; people whose workday runs on Google apps should pick Google AI Pro.

bodyHtml:
Which one should you choose?

Pick Claude Code if you want an agent that works across a whole project — reading code, running tests and fixing errors. It needs a paid Claude plan.

Pick GitHub Copilot if you want completions and chat inside VS Code and other editors, with a free tier to start.
verdict: Claude Code is a terminal-based agent that reads your whole project, writes and edits code, runs tests and fixes errors — the single biggest paid-only advantage in coding, included with Claude Pro at $20 a month. GitHub Copilot is the best in-editor autocomplete: line and function completions, chat and multi-file edits without leaving your IDE, with a free tier. Pick Claude Code for agent work across an entire codebase; pick Copilot if you want AI that feels native inside your editor.

bodyHtml:
Which one should you choose?

Pick Perplexity when the job is research — cited answers you can check, free to start.

Pick ChatGPT when you need one tool for everything else: writing, coding, images, voice and research in a single app.
verdict: Perplexity is the fastest way to research a new topic: ask a question and get a clear answer with citations you can open and check, with a free plan and Pro at $20 a month. ChatGPT is the wider all-rounder — chat, writing, code help, image generation, voice and deep research in one app. Our advice from the big-three comparison: pair one paid chatbot with Perplexity free instead of paying for two chatbots.

bodyHtml:
Which one should you choose?

Pick Perplexity for quick, cited research answers — free to start, and often faster than the big chatbots for facts.

Pick Gemini if your documents and email live in Google Workspace and you want research grounded in your own files.
verdict: Perplexity gives quick cited answers to a question, and its free plan often beats the paid chatbots for fast research. Gemini's Google grounding produces sourced reports too, and it works across Gmail, Docs and Drive with multimodal skills and Veo video through Flow. Pick Perplexity for the fastest research with sources; pick Gemini if your work already lives in Google apps.

bodyHtml:
Which one should you choose?

Pick Midjourney if pure image quality matters more than convenience — it is the most artistic generator we reviewed, but paid-only.

Pick Canva AI if you make social posts and thumbnails every day and want design and AI in one place, with a free plan to start.
verdict: Midjourney is the benchmark for striking AI images — art, product shots and concept work with a distinctive, polished look — but it is paid-only and has a learning curve. Canva AI puts design and AI in one place: generate images, remove backgrounds and resize for every platform, with a free plan and Pro. Pick Midjourney when the visual itself is the product; pick Canva AI for social posts, thumbnails and production speed.

bodyHtml:
Which one should you choose?

Pick Grammarly if you want writing help everywhere you type, with a free plan and no new app to open.

Pick ChatGPT if writing is one job among many — it also codes, researches, generates images and handles voice.
verdict: Grammarly is the best everyday writing polish: grammar, clarity and tone suggestions everywhere you type — email, docs and social — with a free plan and Pro. ChatGPT is the wider tool: it writes, codes, generates images and does deep research, with Plus at $20 a month. Pick Grammarly for always-on polish in every app you write in; pick ChatGPT when you need one tool for everything, not just writing.

bodyHtml:
Which one should you choose?

Pick ChatGPT if you need images plus everything else — writing, coding, research and voice in one subscription.

Pick Midjourney if image quality is the whole job and you are willing to pay for the best-looking results.
verdict: ChatGPT generates and edits images as part of the widest chatbot feature set, alongside chat, writing, coding, voice and deep research, for Plus at $20 a month. Midjourney is the benchmark for pure image quality — the most striking art and photography styles — but it is paid-only with a learning curve. If images are one job among many, ChatGPT covers them; if the image is the product, Midjourney wins on quality.

bodyHtml:
Which one should you choose?

Pick Claude for writing and long documents — the most natural long-form writing we reviewed.

Pick Perplexity for research — cited answers you can check, free to start, and the fastest way to learn a new topic.
verdict: Claude is the best tool for writing and long documents, with the most human-sounding prose and careful reasoning over very long files, for Pro at $20 a month. Perplexity is the best tool for research with sources: clear answers with citations you can open and check, free to start. They complement each other — our advice is to pair one paid chatbot with Perplexity free instead of paying for two chatbots.
